title: CT and MR Perfusion Imaging of Cerebral Infarction
author: Shazia Mirza and Sankalp Gokhale
caption: Multimodal CT and MRI perfusion maps showing ischemic core and salvageable penumbra in acute cerebral infarction.
alt_text: CT and MRI perfusion brain maps highlighting hypoperfused cerebral territory.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates time-dependent ischemic penumbra and neurological disability risk in stroke (CLIFF-059, p.5-6).
